problem.title: Determine the Height of a Binary Search Tree Without Constructing It
problem.problemStatement: Given the insertion order of distinct keys, determine the height of the resulting Binary Search Tree without explicitly constructing the tree.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the insertion sequence.
problem.output: • Print the height of the resulting BST.
